reader.requirement: At --std 85 a REWRITE of a sequential mass-storage file open I-O succeeds and replaces exactly the record the last READ accessed only when the last input-output statement executed for that file was a successful READ; after any other last statement for that file (a REWRITE, successful or not, a failed WRITE, an at-end READ, an OPEN, or nothing) it is unsuccessful with I-O status 43 (VII.1.3.5) and replaces nothing, while I-O on another file does not break the sequence. The witness covers only the successful READ then REWRITE leg.

whether the file sharing facility applies to the connector; false at 85

reader.notes: The gate is one flag dropped at the one Status setter and re-armed only by ReadSucceeded, so every I-O statement on the connector (including a failed REWRITE) breaks it, and it is per connector, so another file's I-O does not. Every probed sequence answered as the 1985 text requires.
